title: Interactive Cat Puzzle Feeder Funny Cat Puzzle Food Dispenser Enrichment Toy For Pets Play And Exercise Green
body_html: 1、PROMOTE POSITIVE EATING HABITS: The unique design allows cats and dogs to enjoy their meals at a slower speed, effectively reducing the risk of overeating and promoting healthier eating habits. 2、ENGAGING ENTERTAINMENT: This feeder toy provides a fun and interactive way for pets to entertain themselves, reducing boredom and stimulating their minds through play. 3、FOOD HIDING DESIGN: The innovative design conceals the food, encouraging pets to expend more energy searching for their meals, making mealtime a fun and rewarding challenge. 4、PROMOTES EXERCISE: By motivating pets to work for their food, this cat puzzle toy helps increase their physical activity, supporting a healthier body and lifestyle. 5、ADJUSTABLE FOOD OUTLET: The adjustable food dispensing outlet accommodates different sizes of food and caters to various pet needs, ensuring a funny feeding experience for every pet.Item Type: Interactive Cat Puzzle FeederMaterial: PlasticSize: Approx. 30x30x8cm / 11.81x11.81x3.15in1 x Cat Puzzle Feeder (5 Components)
